name: TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex

function.text: TARBP2 is the approved symbol for TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in double-stranded RNA binding; enzyme binding; miRNA processing.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma; Endometrial carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TARBP2 encodes TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex. Its functions include double-stranded RNA binding and enzyme binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TARBP2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
